body:
WHAT
A third shape of the runtime-evidence floor, under the same once-per-turn fuse and in the same place on the ladder (ahead of self-verify).
- It fires at a clean end of turn when the turn changed a browser-facing file (.html, .htm, .css, .scss, .sass, .less, .vue, .svelte, .jsx, .tsx — uiFilesAmong) and there is no browser evidence this turn. Browser evidence is: a Read of an image file that succeeded (a screenshot went through the vision model), or a Bash command that drives a browser (playwright, puppeteer, selenium, webdriver, cypress, --headless, --screenshot, chromedp, wkhtmltoimage — looksLikeBrowserRun). The two older shapes (nothing ran; only stand-ins ran) keep priority.
- Its text (finishing.browser-evidence, placeholders files and visionNote) says the page was checked only from the outside, and asks: drive it in a real or headless browser with a throwaway script in the system temp directory, doing each main thing the user asked for with the default settings; read the result (the vision clause, VISION_ON or VISION_OFF, is reused); check that every action gets visible feedback and every rule the user needs is on the screen, not only in the answer; say what was driven and observed. The honest way out is kept: if no browser can run here, say what was checked instead and that the page stays unverified.
- The user sees one line: "↻ the page was never opened in a browser — checking it the way the user will".
- No new tool: the check stays instruction-only (a built-in capture tool would be a new feature).

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, findings V-01, V-05 and R-4. The agent said "complete, verified" after an HTTP-API bot and HTTP 200s for the page files; it never opened the browser client. The owner found four client defects in minutes (mouse aim, player not visible, no hit or kill feedback, STAIRS OPEN never shown). The transcript shows why the harness said nothing: the runtime-evidence rung — the only place that tells the model to capture a screenshot when vision is on — fires only when a turn ran NO command, and this turn ran 45 Bash calls. Vision was on; the VISION_ON clause never reached the model.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts — BROWSER_EVIDENCE, browserEvidenceText(), uiFilesAmong(), looksLikeBrowserRun(). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — browserEvidenceThisTurn (reset at turn start, set in observeTurnWork), the third branch of the RUNTIME EVIDENCE FLOOR.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (pure) uiFilesAmong names .html/.css/.tsx/.vue and not .py/.js/.md; looksLikeBrowserRun is true for a Playwright run, a headless Chromium screenshot and a Puppeteer script, false for curl, python -m http.server and node --check.
2. (pure) The shipped text is a reminder with the slots files and visionNote, says the page was never observed in a browser, asks for the main goals with the default settings, and keeps the honest "stays unverified" ending.
3. (fs) A real engine turn that writes static/index.html and runs a plain command gets the reminder once, with the page named and the note shown, and the next end of turn is allowed.
4. (fs) The same turn with a browser-driving command gets no reminder; a turn that changed only a .py file and ran it gets none either.

ADDED 2026-09-24 (audit follow-up):
- (fs) A mention, an install, a version check or a FAILED browser run is not evidence (cat playwright.config.ts, npx playwright install, npm i -D puppeteer, --version, curl); only a browser run that succeeded, or a Read of an image, is.
- (fs) The browser shape has its own once-per-turn fuse: a page turn told first to run something, that then checks only with curl, is still sent to a browser.
- (fs) .htm/.sass/.less are code and page; a *.test/*.spec/*.stories file is not the page.
